# Action Packer Mod - More useful storage

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Mark a grid on an Action Packer lid, pierce holes with an awl, drill them larger, then thread elastic shock cord through to form parallel lines. [t464]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Buy a several foot length of 3/32-inch elastic shock cord.
2. Mark out a grid pattern on the inside of the Action Packer lid.
3. [Partial] Use a hand awl to pierce holes through opposing sides of the ribs in the lid for starter points.
4. Drill those holes slightly larger than the diameter of the elastic cord.
5. [Partial] Attach heat shrink tubing to one end of the cord and secure it with a short length of copper wire to add rigidity.
6. [Partial] Thread the reinforced cord through the drilled holes on opposite sides of the lid to form parallel lines.
7. [Partial] Pull the cord tight across the grid pattern and tie off both ends.

_Procedure reported by [t464]._

## Tips & gotchas

- Utilize the existing grooves in the lid for organization. [t464]
- Note that the soft plastic of the lid makes drilling very easy and quick. [t464]
